## 主张 Claim

把两次继续作为一个框架的配置、把读法所记入的事件作为实现的主张，比较原则 C 就是这一框架上的 Comparison。对任何只记入活跃事件的读法，没有某个形成的继续扩展有它的继续，仅当读法扣下该形成的每个事件。整段读法（活跃且在该继续中不消耗）下，对支持门控定律族中每个超出更新地汲取的焦点形成，没有它的继续扩展有它的继续，所以每个满足 C 的比较都把前者排得更高。逐步读法（活跃且不侵蚀）下，焦点形成在某步活跃、而该步之后每个所需仍被满足时，这一事件被记入；于是两次继续互不扩展，有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有它的继续。恶性增殖与以消耗取胜都是实例。逐步读法下，以消耗取胜者在损失之前的事件被记入、之后的不被记入，而共享的继续记入每个事件，所以共享仍扩展以消耗取胜。不用 Lean 公理；C 只作为假设或定义出现。 / Taking two continuations as the configurations of a frame and the events a reading credits as its realized claims, comparison principle C is Comparison on that frame. For any reading that credits only active events, the continuation without a formation extends the continuation with it only if the reading withholds every event of that formation. Under the whole-run reading (active and not consuming in that continuation), for every law of the support-gated family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal, the continuation without it extends the continuation with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher. Under the stepwise reading (active and not undermining), an event of the focal formation is credited when it is active and every need is still met after its step; the two continuations then do not extend each other, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with the formation. Malignant growth and winning by consumption are instances. Under the stepwise reading the winner's events before the loss are credited and those after are not, while sharing credits every event, so sharing still extends winning by consumption. No Lean axiom is used; C occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition.

Canonical source: [Ranking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Ranking.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- C 是公开的比较前提，本结果不证明它；“没有焦点形成的继续”与 relational-reading-comparison 相同，其水平由同一定律在焦点形成不出现时给出。 / C is a disclosed comparison premise, not proved here; the continuation without the focal formation is the one of relational-reading-comparison, its levels given by the same law when the focal formation does not occur.
- 逐步读法的结论需要焦点形成有一个使每个所需仍被满足的活跃步；支持门控定律族的前提（所需为正、焦点所需不超过维持者所需、起点支持维持者、从某步起汲取超出更新）如 relational-renewal-classification 所设。 / The stepwise conclusion needs an active step of the focal formation after which every need is still met; the premises of the support-gated family (positive need, focal need within the sustaining need, a start supporting the sustaining formation, drawing beyond renewal from some step on) are those of relational-renewal-classification.

两个排序在逐步读法下分道。若 G0 与 C 共用逐步读法，C 仍把共享排在以消耗取胜之上，却不再把没有恶性增殖的继续排得更高；整段读法两者都保持，代价是独立审查的判据 (b) 与 (c)。若 G0 的记入取逐步读法而 C 取整段读法，两者都保持，但 G0 与 C 不再共用一种 living 读法：形式上两者各以读法为参数，前提卡上 C 所说的“活的内容”却是 G0 的 living，分开取须公开。哪一种是生生的读法，由 Ren 选择。 / The two rankings part ways under the stepwise reading. If G0 and C share the stepwise reading, C still ranks sharing above winning by consumption but no longer ranks the continuation without malignant growth higher; the whole-run reading keeps both, at the cost of the independent review's criteria (b) and (c). If G0's credit takes the stepwise reading and C the whole-run reading, both are kept, but G0 and C no longer share one reading of living: formally each takes its reading as a parameter, while the premise card reads C's “living content” as G0's living, so a split must be disclosed. Which reading is the reading of 生生 is Ren's choice.

只在支持门控定律族与一对比较继续中证明；关系层读法同样记入焦点形成的第一个关系，但未单独形式化；不推出责任、义务或可行性；不选择读法。 / Proved only in the support-gated family and for one pair of compared continuations; the relation-level reading also credits the focal formation's first relation but is not formalized separately; yields no responsibility, duty or feasibility; chooses no reading.

- 逐步读法下 C 不决定恶性增殖与其不在场（malignant_ranking）：有一个满足 C、非自反、传递的比较偏好有恶性增殖的继续。这不是说在场更好，只是说 C 单独不足。 / Under the stepwise reading C does not decide between malignant growth and its absence (malignant_ranking): an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with it. This does not say the occurrence is better, only that C alone is insufficient.
